records.jp: 白井、調子はどう？
records.en_original: How're ya feelin', Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: How're ya feelin', Shirai?
records.en: How're ya feelin', Shirai?

records.jp: 絶好調だよ。圭こそ大丈夫なの？
records.en_original: I've never been better. How about you, Kei?
records.en_auxiliary: I've never been better. How about you, Kei?
records.en: I've never been better. How about you, Kei?

records.jp: もちろん絶好調！　勝負の日にコンディションが整ってないのは、<CR>相手に失礼だからね
records.en_original: I'm in tip top shape! You've gotta be when you're competin'. It's rude to the opponent otherwise!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm in tip top shape! You've gotta be when you're competin'. It's rude to the opponent otherwise!
records.en: Of course I'm in great shape! Competing when you're not at your best<CR>would be rude to your opponent.

records.jp: お互い、言い訳できないくらい、調子はよさそうだね
records.en_original: Good. Then there won't be any excuses once you lose.
records.en_auxiliary: Good. Then there won't be any excuses once you lose.
records.en: Looks like we're both in good enough shape that neither of us can make excuses.

records.jp: 調子よくなかったら降りるつもりだった？
records.en_original: I'm curious, were you planning to back down if you didn't think you were up for it?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm curious, were you planning to back down if you didn't think you were up for it?
records.en: I'm curious, were you planning to back down if you didn't think you were up for it?

records.jp: まさか
records.en_original: Not a chance.
records.en_auxiliary: Not a chance.
records.en: Not a chance.

records.jp: ふふ。それでこそ
records.en_original: Heh heh. Good. That's what I like to hear.
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh. Good. That's what I like to hear.
records.en: Heh heh. Good. That's what I like to hear.

records.jp: 始まる前から火花散ってるねー
records.en_original: Man, the race hasn't even started and you can already feel the electricity between them!
records.en_auxiliary: Man, the race hasn't even started and there's already sparks flying!
records.en: Man, the race hasn't even started and you can already feel the electricity between them!

records.jp: やる気十分だね
records.en_original: It means they're both motivated.
records.en_auxiliary: It means they're both motivated.
records.en: They're both raring to go.

records.jp: はーい！　皆さん、まずは準備体操をしてください
records.en_original: Okay, ladies! Don't forget to do your warm-ups before you jump in!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, ladies! Don't forget to do your warm-ups before you jump in!
records.en: Okay, ladies! Don't forget to do your warm-ups before you jump in!

records.jp: よし……！
records.en_original: Right...!
records.en_auxiliary: All right!
records.en: Right...!

records.jp: うわっ、何それ白井！　タコみたい！
records.en_original: Whoa! Dang, Shirai, you're like an octopus!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa! Dang, Shirai, you're like an octopus!
records.en: Whoa! Dang, Shirai, you're like an octopus!

records.jp: わぁ、やっぱり日菜子ちゃんはすごいなぁ……
records.en_original: Wow, she's just as flexible as ever...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, she's just as flexible as ever...
records.en: Wow, Hinako-chan is as amazing as ever...

records.en_original: Oof... Phew...!
records.en_auxiliary: Oof... Phew...!
records.en: Oof... Phew...!

records.jp: なに？　柔軟は基本でしょ？
records.en_original: How about that? Flexibility's key for swimming, right?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Flexibility's key for swimming, right?
records.en: What? Stretching is basic, isn't it?

records.jp: ほほう。どうやら運動ができるっていうのは本当みたいだね
records.en_original: Oho. Seems like you weren't kidding about being athletic.
records.en_auxiliary: Oho. Seems like you weren't kidding about being athletic.
records.en: Oho. Seems like you weren't kidding about being athletic.

records.jp: ふふふ、どうだ！
records.en_original: Heh heh heh, so there!
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh heh, how do you like that?
records.en: Heh heh heh, so there!

records.jp: どうしてユズが得意げなの？
records.en_original: Why are you acting so cocky, Yuzu?
records.en_auxiliary: Why are you acting so cocky, Yuzu?
records.en: Why are you acting so cocky, Yuzu?

records.jp: 柔軟に集中してるヒナちゃんの心を代弁したの
records.en_original: Well, Hina's so busy doing her stretches, I figured I'd gloat for her!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, Hina's busy doing her stretches, so I figured I'd gloat for her!
records.en: I was putting Hina-chan's feelings into words while she focused on stretching.

records.jp: あなたたちも柔軟しなさーい！
records.en_original: Hey! Why don't I see the rest of you girls warming up!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey! Why don't I see the rest of you girls warming up?
records.en: Hey! Why don't I see the rest of you girls warming up!?

records.jp: すみませーん！
records.en_original: Sorry!
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry!
records.en: Sorry!

records.jp: よし、みんな上がったし、そろそろ勝負を始めようか！
records.en_original: Okay, now that everyone's out, let's get this thing started!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, now that everyone's out, let's get this thing started!
records.en: Okay, now that everyone's out, let's get this thing started!

records.jp: いつでもいいよ。私は準備万端だから
records.en_original: I'm ready when you are, just say the word.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm ready when you are, just say the word.
records.en: I'm ready when you are, just say the word.

records.jp: いよいよだね、私がどきどきしてきたよ
records.en_original: Finally. My heart's already pounding.
records.en_auxiliary: Finally. My heart's already pounding.
records.en: Finally. My heart's already pounding.

records.jp: ルールを確認するよ。５０メートルターンの時に、<CR>５秒以上の差をつけたほうが勝ち。オッケー？
records.en_original: So, just to go over the rules again, whoever has a five second lead on the other after a 50 meter turn wins. Okay?
records.en_auxiliary: So, just to go over the rules again, whoever has a five second lead on the other after a 50 meter turn wins. Okay?
records.en: Let's confirm the rules. At a 50-meter turn,<CR>whoever has a lead of at least five seconds wins. Okay?

records.jp: 大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: Fine by me.
records.en_auxiliary: Fine by me.
records.en: Fine by me.

records.jp: あれ、５０メートルの競泳じゃないんだ？
records.en_original: Wait, huh? It's not a regular 50 meter swimming race?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, huh? It's not a regular 50 meter swimming race?
records.en: Wait, huh? It's not a regular 50 meter swimming race?

records.jp: うんうん。ちょっと特殊なルールかもね
records.en_original: Nope. This match has some special rules.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope. This match has some special rules.
records.en: Nope. This match has some special rules.

records.jp: 僅差だとどっちが勝ったかわかりづらいからね
records.en_original: Swimming races can be hard to judge, especially when the swimmers are closely matched.
records.en_auxiliary: Swimming races can be hard to judge, especially when the swimmers are closely matched.
records.en: Swimming races can be hard to judge, especially when the swimmers are closely matched.

records.jp: ということは、同じくらいの実力だったら持久力勝負かぁ
records.en_original: I see... So the five second rule turns it into a test of stamina versus speed.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... So the five second rule turns it into a test of stamina versus speed.
records.en: So if they're evenly matched, it'll turn into a contest of endurance.

records.jp: お昼休み、なくなっちゃわない？
records.en_original: But won't our lunch break be over by the time someone wins?
records.en_auxiliary: But won't our lunch break be over by the time someone wins?
records.en: But won't our lunch break be over by the time someone wins?

records.jp: それじゃあ始めるよ。審判は……決めてなかったね
records.en_original: Then we better get started! ...Except I just realized we haven't chosen a referee.
records.en_auxiliary: Then we better get started! ...Except I just realized we haven't chosen a referee.
records.en: Then let's begin. The referee is... Oh, we never chose one.

records.jp: えっと……西田、お願い！
records.en_original: Hmm... You've got this, right Nishida?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... You've got this, right Nishida?
records.en: Um... Nishida, please!

records.jp: わ、私？　タイム見ていればいいの？
records.en_original: M-Me? So, I just keep my eye on the time?
records.en_auxiliary: M-me? So I just need to keep my eye on the time?
records.en: M-Me? So, I just keep my eye on the time?

records.jp: ライムたちも手伝うよ
records.en_original: Yuzu and I can help you out, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and I can help you out, too.
records.en: Lime and the others will help too.

records.jp: あれ？　白井、飛び込み苦手？
records.en_original: Hm? Are you a weak diver, Shirai?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? Are you a weak diver, Shirai?
records.en: Hm? Are you a weak diver, Shirai?

records.jp: まあ、そんなとこ
records.en_original: Something like that.
records.en_auxiliary: Something like that.
records.en: Something like that.

records.jp: そっか、ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Right, I almost forgot...
records.en_auxiliary: Right, I almost forgot...
records.en: I see, Hina-chan...

records.jp: これは、不利になっちゃうね……
records.en_original: This does leave her at quite a disadvantage...
records.en_auxiliary: This does leave her at quite a disadvantage...
records.en: This does leave her at quite a disadvantage...

records.jp: これで、言い訳は成立しないっと
records.en_original: Here we go. This way you won't get to blame your loss on my dive.
records.en_auxiliary: Here we go. This way you won't get to blame your loss on my dive.
records.en: There. Now neither of us can use the start as an excuse.

records.jp: 絶対に負けない
records.en_original: I'm not gonna lose.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not gonna lose.
records.en: I'm not gonna lose.

records.jp: アタイこそ！　正々堂々、良い勝負しようね！
records.en_original: Neither am I! Let's make this a good one!
records.en_auxiliary: Neither am I! Let's make this a good one!
records.en: Same here! Let's play fair and make it a good match!

records.jp: それじゃあ……いくよ
records.en_original: On your marks! Get set...
records.en_auxiliary: On your marks! Get set...
records.en: On your marks! Get set...

records.jp: ――スタート！
records.en_original: GO!
records.en_auxiliary: GO!
records.en: GO!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん頑張れー！
records.en_original: You've got this Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: You've got this, Hina!
records.en: You've got this, Hina-chan!

records.jp: がんばれ！
records.en_original: You can do it!
records.en_auxiliary: You can do it!
records.en: You can do it!

records.jp: 日菜子ちゃ……あ、審判は平等じゃないといけないんだよね？
records.en_original: Go, go, Hi-- Oh, whoops, the ref's supposed to be impartial...
records.en_auxiliary: Go, go, Hi—Oh, whoops, the ref's supposed to be impartial...
records.en: Go, go, Hi-- Oh, whoops, the ref's supposed to be impartial...

records.jp: えっと、どっちもがんばれー！
records.en_original: Erm... Go, go, both of you!
records.en_auxiliary: Erm... Go, go, both of you!
records.en: Erm... Go, go, both of you!

records.jp: （くっ……圭、本気だ……だったら私も本気で応えなきゃ）
records.en_original: (Dang it... Kei isn't messing around. I've really gotta give this my all!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Dang it... Kei isn't messing around. I've really gotta give this my all!)
records.en: (Kei is serious... Then I have to match her and give this everything I've got.)

records.jp: （差が縮まらない……水泳部ほどじゃないけど、<CR>やっぱり圭も運動部だよね）
records.en_original: (I'm not catching up at all... Kei's not part of the swimming club, but her athletic background really shows.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'm not catching up at all... Kei's not part of the swimming club, but her athletic background really shows.)
records.en: (I'm not closing the gap... She may not be in the Swimming Club,<CR>but Kei is still an athlete.)

records.jp: （勝負どころを見極めないと……！）
records.en_original: (I'll need to keep an eye out for my moment...!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I'll need to keep an eye out for my moment...!)
records.en: (I'll need to keep an eye out for my moment...!)

records.jp: （圭、ここじゃ勝負してこなかった）
records.en_original: (Huh. Kei didn't try to pull ahead here...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Huh. Kei didn't try to pull ahead here...)
records.en: (Kei didn't make her move here.)

records.jp: （圭の心理を読むなら……<CR>持久戦を仕掛けてくる、つもりかな）
records.en_original: (What is she thinking...? I guess she must be trying to tire me out and win the battle of endurance...)
records.en_auxiliary: (What is she thinking...? I guess she must be trying to tire me out and win the battle of endurance...)
records.en: (If I'm reading Kei right...<CR>she's planning to turn this into a battle of endurance.)

records.jp: （どうする、次で勝負に出る？）
records.en_original: (What can I do? How can I turn this around?)
records.en_auxiliary: (What can I do? How can I turn this around?)
records.en: (What do I do? Make my move on the next lap?)

records.jp: （でも、引き離されないので精一杯なのに、<CR>どうすればいいんだろう？）
records.en_original: (It's all I can do to keep up, let alone outswim her... How can I make this work?)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's all I can do to keep up, let alone outswim her... How can I make this work?)
records.en: (But it's taking everything I have just to keep her from pulling away.<CR>What am I supposed to do?)

records.jp: （持久戦に応じて勝機を窺う？）
records.en_original: (Is there a chance I could outlast her?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Is there a chance I could outlast her?)
records.en: (Should I go along with the endurance battle and wait for an opening?)

records.jp: （えっ、なんで？　指輪が光った！？）
records.en_original: (Wait, huh? Why's the ring shining!?
records.en_auxiliary: (Wait, huh? Why's the ring shining?!)
records.en: (Huh? Why...? The ring lit up!?)

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！　来るよ！
records.en_original: Hina! We're coming!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina! We're coming!
records.en: Hina-chan! It's coming!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん！
records.en_original: Hina!
records.en_auxiliary: Hina!
records.en: Hina-chan!
